notes.title: Ducking Grenades Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear Fellow Duckies!

I am excited to announce that the demo of Ducking Grenades is finally available! 

Give it a try by downloading the free demo from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934660/Ducking_Grenades/]Demo Steam Page[/url] and please leave a review with any feedback you may have for the game!
